notablePrerequisites:
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Auton Soldier do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Auton Soldier.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Auton Soldier.
Activate Auton Soldier by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
